canonical_wording_en: We define a contract-centric, regime-aware safe adaptive dual-loop in which MAP decoding owns logical-error performance, regime/event/fallback logic owns tail safety, and the FPGA fast path owns deterministic execution.
canonical_wording_zh: 本项目已冻结 contract-centric、regime-aware 安全自适应双回路：MAP 负责逻辑错误性能，regime/event/fallback 负责 tail 安全，FPGA fast path 负责确定性执行。
revocation_conditions: a component is allowed to claim another component's metric | lane nonmixing is removed
forbidden_wording: one model solves decoding, safety and hardware latency | global leaderboard

canonical_wording_en: The production fast-path core is cycle-exact against an independent integer reference over one million board-independent CXXRTL qualification cycles.
canonical_wording_zh: production fast-path core 已在板卡无关 CXXRTL 中以独立整数 reference 完成百万周期全字段 cycle-exact 资格验证。
revocation_conditions: source/trace hash changes without rerun | any bit mismatch or undefined action appears
forbidden_wording: board validated | transport qualified | measured FPGA latency

metrics: Fmax | LUT | FF | BRAM | DSP | core_latency_cycles
canonical_wording_en: The current fixed-point fast path has a target-device-specific three-seed place-and-route timing and resource estimate; it is not a board measurement.
canonical_wording_zh: 当前定点 fast path 具有目标器件、三 seed 的 P&R 时序/资源估计，但不是板测。
activation_gate: source/constraint hashes and all three P&R seeds pass
revocation_conditions: tool report or constraint hash changes | estimate is presented without target/clock qualifier
forbidden_wording: measured power | board timing | vendor signoff

canonical_wording_en: [Conditional; not currently supported] Under a shared protocol-aligned trace and compute contract, Route-A reduces aggregate and tail logical error relative to the strongest deployable static GKP decoder.
canonical_wording_zh: 仅当同 trace/预算证据通过时，Route-A 才可声称相对最强可部署 static GKP decoder 改善 aggregate/tail LER。
activation_gate: T6.7.1 and T6.7.2 pass | T6.8.1 same-trace paired CI supports the claim
revocation_conditions: aggregate paired 95% LCB is not positive | any preregistered tail gate fails
forbidden_wording: universal GKP superiority | surface-code threshold | state-of-the-art GKP decoder

data_domain: held-out smooth and abrupt/OOD syndrome scenarios
canonical_wording_en: [Conditional; not currently supported] Under matched history, update cadence and compute budget, Route-A improves drift adaptation without violating preregistered abrupt/OOD safety margins.
canonical_wording_zh: 仅在 matched history/cadence/预算与 OOD 安全门通过后，才声称 Route-A 具有一般漂移适应优势。
activation_gate: T6.7.1, T6.7.2 and T6.7.4 pass | T6.8.2 includes at least one reproducible external method
revocation_conditions: external implementation is unavailable | catastrophic-degradation or nominal non-inferiority gate fails
forbidden_wording: adaptive decoding is universally superior | all noise regimes

metrics: p95_LER | worst_window_LER | avoided_errors | induced_errors | false_update | unnecessary_fallback
canonical_wording_en: [Conditional; not currently supported] Regime-triggered freeze, trusted-bank switching and fail-closed fallback reduce harmful tail events without unacceptable nominal fallback cost.
canonical_wording_zh: 仅当 abrupt/OOD 与 nominal non-inferiority 门同时通过时，才声称 regime freeze/trusted-bank/fallback 改善 tail 安全。
activation_gate: T6.7.2 independent formal evaluation passes | T6.7.4 promotion gate passes
revocation_conditions: calibration-shift counterexample persists | nominal fallback cost exceeds frozen margin

canonical_wording_en: The legacy CNN residual is a replaceable matched-budget ablation and is not required for the Route-A system claim.
canonical_wording_zh: legacy CNN residual 仅是 matched-budget 可替换消融，不是 Route-A 成立前提。
activation_gate: may be promoted only by its own T6.6/T6.7 matched gate
revocation_conditions: matched comparison fails | checkpoint is absent or cost is unmatched
forbidden_wording: CNN is generally optimal | CNN drives the primary contribution | learned decoder is universally superior

canonical_wording_en: A low-dimensional student retains a preregistered fraction of teacher gain in the existing bounded project controller simulator, but this is neither official GQF reproduction nor decoder evidence.
canonical_wording_zh: 低维 student 在既有受限 controller simulator 中具有预注册 teacher gain-retention 证据，但不等于官方 GQF 复现，也不是 decoder 证据。
activation_gate: existing T4.4.5 bounded branch remains current
revocation_conditions: official GQF is implied | long-horizon/OOD retention is implied | controller result is used as decoder evidence
forbidden_wording: official GQF reproduction | surpasses Puviani NMF | RNN decoder

canonical_wording_en: [Not currently claimable] In the same official GQF environment and budget, the Route-A extension improves logical-channel lifetime over Puviani NMF.
canonical_wording_zh: [当前禁止] 在同一官方 GQF 环境与预算下超过 Puviani NMF 的 logical-channel lifetime。
activation_gate: T6.8.3 intake passes | T6.8.4 paper-exact reproduction passes | T6.8.5 paired lifetime 95% LCB > 0
revocation_conditions: absolute values or ordering miss reproduction tolerance | paired lifetime LCB is not positive
forbidden_wording: currently surpasses NMF | Puviani lifetime record

canonical_wording_en: [Not currently claimable] The Route-A FPGA decoder is faster than existing FPGA QEC decoders on a matched task boundary.
canonical_wording_zh: [当前禁止] Route-A FPGA decoder 在同任务边界下比现有 FPGA QEC decoder 更快。
activation_gate: T6.8.6 comparable subset is non-null | T6.9.2 same-bitstream board measurement passes
revocation_conditions: only core/P&R estimate is available | code/problem/precision/latency boundary differs | any board deadline miss occurs
forbidden_wording: fastest FPGA decoder | measured speed advantage | real-time board result

canonical_wording_en: [Not currently claimable] The system exceeds physical break-even or a measured physical-memory lifetime record.
canonical_wording_zh: [当前禁止] 系统超过真实物理 break-even 或物理存储寿命记录。
activation_gate: protocol-aligned physical-device experiment with registered passive reference and lifetime uncertainty
revocation_conditions: evidence is simulation, CXXRTL, P&R or board-only digital control
forbidden_wording: real break-even | exceeds Sivak 2023 | physical lifetime record
